title: crataegus macracantha var. rhombifolia
intro: Crataegus macracantha var. rhombifolia, commonly known as the Chinese hawthorn, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. It is used in traditional Chinese medicine to promote cardiovascular health, lower blood pressure, and reduce the risk of heart disease due to its health benefits, which include acting as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and cardioprotective agent. The therapeutic actions of Crataegus macracantha var. rhombifolia include vasodilation, improvement of blood lipid profiles, and enhancement of myocardial function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
